title: Memory review-queue contract (.review-queue.json)
description: Validates the .review-queue.json state file that lives beside .consolidation-state.json under the memory state tier. The guaranteed-surfacing substrate: holds every unaddressed memory-review item with severity, state, defer/dismiss counts, and class. Repo-only (inline-validated like memory-schema/rules-schema, not adopter-shipped). Producers append via hooks/lib/review-queue.sh::enqueue_item (block-and-log). The SessionStart banner + UserPromptSubmit re-firing mandate + Stop-block read it.

item_classes.revalidation: STALE memory (≥180d) due for re-validation. Low severity; surfaces as a SINGLE aggregated banner line ('N memories due for revalidation'). EXEMPT from the 3-strike auto-suppress. At ≥360d (EXPIRED) escalates to medium-severity itemized {revalidate|supersede|archive}.
item_classes.hygiene: Mechanical consolidation finding (orphan/dead-ref/temporal/index-budget). Low/medium severity. Auto-suppresses after 3 ignores and logs a tuning signal.
item_classes.conflict: Semantic contradiction surfaced by mem-promote (candidate asserts ¬P where a memory asserts P) OR a supersession adjudication. HIGH severity → the only class that may reach the Stop-block (which yields to R-26). NEVER auto-resolved.
item_classes.promotion: A mem-promote proposal (ADD/MERGE-INTO/NARROW/SUPERSEDE) awaiting propose-then-confirm review.

_design_notes.clear_condition: An item leaves the queue (state → confirmed | rejected) ONLY on explicit confirm OR reject-with-reason — never on silent dismiss, session-exit, or bare defer.
_design_notes.anti_fatigue: defer requires a reason and caps at defer_count=2 then force-escalates; low-severity hygiene findings auto-suppress after dismiss_count=3 (revalidation is exempt).

id.description: Stable item id (dedupe key; enqueue_item is idempotent on it).

severity.description: Severity tier. Gates escalation: low never reaches the Stop-block; high CONFLICT may (yielding to R-26).

state.description: Lifecycle state. open = unaddressed; deferred = bare defer (counts toward force-escalate); confirmed/rejected = cleared (the only clear-conditions); suppressed = auto-suppressed after 3 dismisses (hygiene only, not revalidation).

defer_count.description: Number of times deferred. Caps at 2 then force-escalates (re-firing mandate trigger).

dismiss_count.description: Number of times ignored. Low-severity hygiene auto-suppresses at 3 + logs a tuning signal; revalidation is exempt.

summary.description: Plain-language one-line impact for the diff-style review.

enqueued_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the item entered the queue. Drives the aged>Nd escalation.

memory_ref.description: Slug or path of the memory file the item concerns (when applicable).

defer_reason.description: Required when state=deferred (defer requires a reason; anti-fatigue).

payload.description: Class-specific detail (e.g., a mem-promote proposal artifact or a CONFLICT artifact surfaced side-by-side).
